title: Update all system and AUR packages with paru
summary: Synchronize package lists and upgrade all installed packages, including those from the AUR. This is the standard way to keep an Arch-based system up to date when using paru.

steps.explain: Run paru without arguments to synchronize the package database and upgrade all outdated packages. It will prompt for confirmation before proceeding.

rollback.explain: There is no simple command to downgrade all packages at once. If an update breaks your system, you may need to manually downgrade specific packages using 'paru -U' with older package files or check the Arch Wiki for recovery steps.

warnings: Always read the news on the Arch Linux website before updating, as major updates may require manual intervention.
Ensure you have enough disk space for the download and build process.
